Plot the raw values next to the normalized values, before and after

Source: R/normalization.R
plot_normalization_before_after.Rd

Shows the raw marker ratio (before) side by side with the percent-of-control value (after normalize_to_control()), one pair of panels per marker, so you can see at a glance what control normalization did to the data.

Usage

plot_normalization_before_after(.data, treatment_column_name = "Treatment")

Arguments

.data

Data frame that has been through normalize_to_control() on the long format (must contain "marker_positivity_ratio", "pct_of_control", "marker_positivity" and a treatment column).

treatment_column_name

Column holding the treatment label. Defaults to "Treatment".

Value

A ggplot object.

Examples

df <- data.frame(
  PID = "PID1",
  Treatment = c("Control", "Control", "DrugA", "DrugA", "DrugB", "DrugB"),
  marker_positivity = "cCASP3",
  marker_positivity_ratio = c(10, 12, 4, 6, 18, 20)
)
normalized <- normalize_to_control(df)
plot_normalization_before_after(normalized)
